methods: Formalize a missing boundary lemma identified by the selected review.

first_step.inspect: Inventory the gate-operand parity lemma (#3807) and certified endpoint arithmetic (#3857). Neither is a full multiplication proof. For #4100, audit the compact-switch statement and its hypotheses before formalizing it.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4100: compact-switch formalization proposed as future validation.
existing_checks.remaining: Audit the statement and assumptions before a formal proof campaign.

actual_scope: Close PR4657's identity-pivot Schur dimension gap: prove the six-map criterion and the exact minimum n(H)=4d+nullity(H+H^2) for every prescribed binary d-by-d H, with an attaining construction.
scope_change_reason: Handoff-first continuation of the explicitly open singular-H+H^2 question in PR4657 and Discussion4653. This is a written algebraic side theorem with exact finite corroboration, rather than a Lean formalization or selected-caller audit.
bottleneck_link: A scoped side result: resolves the dimension-existence boundary in the block-Schur/header lineage. It does not discharge selected supplier assumptions, count headers, price physical access or improve kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after the fixed-H lower bound and attainment or a counterexample. Close the dimension question if proved; no automatic density search or supplier expansion.
evidence: README Sections 1-3 prove the theorem. verify.py checks all 530 H of sizes 1-3, an optimal d=2..12 family, a literal nilpotent 13-by-13 pair, padding, 1472 exhaustive small ordered pairs and ten rejection controls. Registered ordinary/optimized Python 3.12 replay and source/export checks are recorded in the PR.
author: ssafwann
ai_assistance: Prepared for ssafwann with substantial OpenAI Codex (gpt-6-astra) assistance, by one agent; no delegated agents. Apache-2.0.

open_questions.question: For one fixed commuting binary idempotent pair, count complete coordinate headers that give identity pivots and satisfy all six full-rank sector-map conditions.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Existence and minimum dimension do not provide the complete-header density needed by the earlier interface setting.
open_questions.first_step: Choose a small fixed joint-sector decomposition; enumerate complete invertible headers and compare six-map acceptance with directly computed Schur-commutator ranks.
open_questions.blocked_by: A specified header ensemble and treatment of dependencies among the six conditions; any later supplier use additionally needs a physical contract and complete costs.

overlap.limits: Open PR bodies, Discussion bodies/comments/replies and in-scope local notes; not all code diffs, closed remote PRs or unpublished work.

family_decision.decision: narrow; stop the dimension line after the exact theorem
family_decision.contract: Commuting binary idempotents with common I_d pivots and prescribed leading block H of PQ; output is maximal Schur-commutator rank and minimum dimension.
family_decision.proved: Written factorization, six-map equivalence, sector lower bounds and attaining construction; finite exact corroboration.
family_decision.unknown: Header selection/emission, physical reads, owned/borrowed state, dirty compensation/restoration, stock, dispatch and the complete consumer bill. Unknown costs are not zero.
family_decision.decision_changed: Closes the dimension-existence gap, including d=3,n=11 and every singular H; no claimed paid-work removal.
family_decision.reopen_only: A separately specified density or caller question with ensemble, boundary contract and cost allowance.
